about: madar_catalog::combo — hand-computed (each case's `why` holds the working). quote: parts in slot order; the combo price P is split over the parts by alloc::split with weight = the included size's price x pick quantity; a part's line_total = its share + its surcharge; add-ons are extra at their normal prices. Figures are per ONE combo unit except the whole-line ones (quantity, combo_share, combo_surcharge, line_total, addons_total), which are for n units.

cases.name: lunch_large_latte_n2
cases.why: every whole-line figure doubles: 17142 / 5716 / 7142+2000=9142, add-ons 3000.

cases.name: picks_out_of_order_are_ordered_by_slot
cases.why: parts follow slot sort, the split follows the parts: same 8571/2858/3571; list 21000; saving 6000.

cases.name: owner_size_surcharge_beats_the_difference
cases.why: the owner's Large surcharge is 500 (the difference would be 1000). unit_total 15500; list 22000; saving 6500.

cases.name: fixed_bundle_no_size_takes_the_cheapest
cases.why: no included size and no picked size: the cheapest active (Regular 5000). weights 5000/3500 (W 8500): round(7000*5000/8500)=4118 (4117.65) -> 4118/2882. list 8500; saving 1500.

cases.name: included_is_the_cheapest_effective_price
cases.why: Small is 3000 in the catalogue but 3600 at the branch, so Medium (3500) is the cheapest; 6000 over 3500/3500 = 3000/3000. list 7000.

cases.name: a_bigger_effective_size_costs_the_difference
cases.why: Small 3600 (branch) over Medium 3500 = 100. unit_total 6100; list 7100.

cases.name: category_choice
cases.why: cola is admitted by the category choice. weights 12000/2500 (W 14500): round(10000*12000/14500)=8276 (8275.86) -> 8276/1724. list 14500.

cases.name: the_item_choice_wins_over_its_category
cases.why: juice has its own choice (surcharge 500) as well as its category. weights 12000/3000: 8000/2000. unit_total 10500; list 15000.

cases.name: min_zero_slot_left_empty
cases.why: the dessert slot is optional; nothing changes.

cases.name: all_free_picks_split_equally
cases.why: every weight 0 -> equal per PART: 900 over 1/1 = 450/450. list 0, so the saving is -900.

cases.name: two_of_one_slot_with_a_choice_surcharge_n3
cases.why: surcharge 200 per burger: whole line 3*2*200=1200; burger line 64287+1200=65487, qty 6; fries 10713, qty 3. unit_total 25000+2*200=25400.
